baseline_scanner.note: This is the locked pre-repair reveal. It is preserved unchanged after adjudication.

summary.validation: Each repair is covered by targeted positive/negative regressions and passed its PR CI/CodeQL gates. No new broad Frozen-180 result is claimed here.

repair.summary: Provider-managed ADK BuiltInCodeExecutor no longer implies host process.execute, and read-only policy naming no longer implies IAM/admin authority.

cases.validation: Targeted precision regressions plus green CI/CodeQL on the repair PR.

repair.summary: Repository-level BaseTool binding proves model-selected object lookup/mutation and compares it with the owner/tenant check enforced by the normal application path.

cases.validation: Positive owner-scope bypass regression plus a principal-bound owner-check negative; green CI/CodeQL before merge.
cases.limitation: Cross-owner impact still requires a valid object identifier outside the caller's authorized scope.

repair.summary: Source analysis binds publish-capable LiveKit session issuance to the consuming model agent, resolves function-tool to local MCP dispatch, and follows repository helpers to committed state mutation.

cases.validation: Positive public-session to SQLite mutation regression plus authenticated-token and non-publishing-token negatives; CI and CodeQL both passed.
cases.limitation: The pinned source proves repository-local/demo SQLite banking state, not a production banking backend.

repair.summary: Pydantic tool names such as run_command no longer imply host process.execute; a concrete subprocess/os.system/exec/eval-class sink is required.

cases.validation: Authorized application-command registry negative plus existing true process-execution positives; green CI/CodeQL on the repair PR.

conclusions: Batch 005 found two source-proven recall/composition gaps and two independent precision gap families in five fresh cases.

The recall gaps were not basic entity discovery failures: both required composing application admission/authorization boundaries with effective model-tool authority and a concrete state-changing sink.
The precision gaps reinforced the need to distinguish provider-managed capabilities from local host authority and semantic names from source-proven sinks.
The next study step is a fresh blinded Batch 006; broad Frozen-180 validation remains a deliberate manual gate rather than a per-PR loop.
